annotations.title: Data center energy on the site climate

description: Data center campus energy study on the real climate of the place: PUE, facility energy, free / adiabatic / chiller cooling hours, water use, peak cooling, waste heat for district heating, roof PV. it_mw = IT load in MW; ai = high-density AI halls. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call. Typical questions: "PUE, free-cooling hours and water use of a 100 MW data center in Ankara (39.93, 32.86)"; "PUE, free-cooling hours and water use of a 20 MW AI (high-density) data center in Berlin, Germany (52.52, 13.40)"; "PUE, free-cooling hours and water use of a 20 MW AI (high-density) data center in Houston, Texas (29.76, -95.37)"; "PUE, free-cooling hours and water use of a 10 MW AI (high-density) data center in Dubai, UAE (25.20, 55.27)".
